title: Joe Quesada
description: What prompted Joe Quesada to render the Jedi Master Yoda? "He looks like my cat!" Quesada has illustrated more comic covers than he can remember. His accomplishments include the RAG 6-issue mini-series for DC comics, the BATMAN/SWORD OF AZREAL 4-issue mini-series (also for DC) and monthly pencilling duties on Marvel's X-FACTOR. Quesada "desperately needs a day off," and knows Mike Mignola personally.
